rows: A moth does not own the light. It knows where the lamp is, and so do I: the armbar starts in the corner.
Brawling looks like weather from the far rows. From the ring, it is one step after another.
The gamble is a window left open. Tell me which hold you will try when it swings shut.
Time, to me, is a long exhale. Then the next move comes.
The people want something they can keep. Give them a moment they can hold onto.
I am here, and I know what I came to do.
I am known for an image. I want the image to lead to a result.
Look at the shape of the stance. It is a held breath, and I know when to let it go.
You describe technique like a painting. Name the hold, then I will see the brush stroke.
Strikes are a colour. The technique is the shape they make.
A gamble should leave a mark. Otherwise it is only a sketch.
A stall is a still life. A pin needs movement, so I will take it from you.
The crowd came for something that moves. Give them one.
You want to be seen. I can see you, and I can see where you are standing.
I can see your {strength} clearly, and where it lands. It is a clear image, and I know exactly where it lands.
I have studied your {strength}, and I know the place where it stops working.
You kept composed. That is a steady image, and I like it.
Fair shape, then. We agree on what we can see from here, and I will take the rest on the mat.
I could raise my voice. I would rather hold the moment.
One fall, one clean image. Keep me down, and the match is yours.
On the mat it gets close. Stay inside the lines.
Grounded or standing, the match still belongs to us.
Stand up where I can see you. Let the crowd see what you do.
A good answer, well placed. Now let us see it move.
The shape is still empty. The silence is a shape, and I notice it.
Fair shape, then. That is a moment worth keeping.
I concede that image. I will show you the rest in the ring.
I will give this match everything, until the bell brings it to an end.
My approach is precise, and I will show you the detail on the night.
Whatever happens, the result will be honest.
The ending is not drawn yet. I like that.
I have one more image, and you will see it when the bell rings.
